content: स्तम्भ् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ; €5. €9 <ab>P.</ab> (स्तम्भते, स्तभ्नोति, स्तभ्नाति, स्तम्भित or स्तब्ध; the स् of the root being changed to ष् after prepositions ending in इ or उ and also after अब) .²1 To stop, hinder, arrest, suppress; कण्ठः स्ताम्भितबाष्पवृत्तिकलुषः <ls>Ś. 4. 5</ls>. .²2 To make firm or stiff, to make immoveable. .²3 To stupefy, paralyze, benumb; प्राणा दध्वंसिरे गात्रं तस्तम्भे च प्रिये हते <ls>Bk. 14. 55</ls>. .²4 To prop, support, uphold, sustain. .²5 To become stiff, rigid or immoveable. .²6 To be proud or elated, be stiff-necked. .²7 To occupy, spread; ततः पुण्याहघोषोऽभूद्दिवं स्तब्ध्वेव भारत <ls>Mb. 12. 38. 19</ls>. (The following verse illustrates the root in its different conjugations:-- स्तम्भते पुरुषः प्रायो यौवनेन धनेन च . न स्तभ्नाति क्षितीशोऽपि न स्तभ्नोति युवाप्यसौ ..). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्तम्भयति-ते) .²1 To stop, arrest. .²2 To make firm or rigid. .²3 To paralyze. .²4 To prop, support. .²5 To suppress, check.
